THE COUTURE APPROACH

Reflection creates possibility.

Rate 15 equally weighted reflections across five dimensions from 1 (rarely) to 5 (consistently), based on your recent experience.

Scores use (average response − 1) ÷ 4 × 100. Live scores include answered reflections only and are provisional until all 15 are answered.

This is a personal reflection tool, not a validated psychometric assessment. Responses are saved locally in this browser. “Reset assessment” in your report removes them.
